summary: Atlas iteration-2 backend tested end-to-end: 35/35 pytest tests passing (100%). New iteration-2 suite (13 tests) covers POST /api/upload (happy path + content-type/size/auth validation), GET /api/files/{path} with query-token auth + isolation, POST /api/images accepting storage_path or url, rich Financial seed_quotes (8) + seed_images (4), >=9 Financial premise prompts incl. 'philosophy about money', and idempotent additive re-seeding that preserves answers and creates no duplicates. The iteration-1 regression suite (22 tests) was re-run and all pass — no regression.

minor.issue: Still silently return {ok: true} when no record matches (no 404). Per agent-to-agent note, this is intentional and preserved as-is.

critical_code_review_comments: storage.py module-level _storage_key cache is fine for single worker but would not be shared across uvicorn workers; each worker init_storage()'s lazily on first upload — acceptable. If moved to multi-worker, each worker will redundantly init which is still OK.

put_object / get_object raise raw HTTPError on non-2xx from Emergent Object Storage; server.py wraps in a generic 500 'Upload failed' / 'Download failed'. Consider surfacing storage-provider HTTP status + body snippet in logs only (already done via logger.exception).

GET /api/files/{path:path} correctly uses query-param token because cannot send headers (per playbook). Token is the same long-lived 30-day JWT — consider minting a short-scoped (e.g., 1-hour, purpose='file-read') token for file URLs so leaking an URL doesn't leak the full-access bearer.

ImageIn now has url='' and storage_path='' both optional — server stores whichever is provided. Consider validating that at least one is non-empty (currently both empty is accepted and would render nothing).
_ensure_user_seeded is now truly additive and idempotent — verified by test: existing entry id/answer/version preserved across 3 re-seed calls, no duplicate question text. ✓

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES enforced AFTER file.read() — for a truly hostile client this means we still buffer up to ~client-bandwidth*timeout bytes in memory before rejecting. For 8MB cap this is fine; at larger caps consider streaming with a running counter, or enforce via CONTENT_LENGTH header check first.

Financial seed content exactly matches PS spec: 9 premise / 9 purpose / 9 vision / 15 strategy = 42 prompts; 8 seed_quotes (Lowell, Tucker, Thatcher, Franklin x2, Wilde, Seneca, Kiyosaki); 4 seed_images. ✓
Data isolation for /api/files verified — user B gets 404 (not 403) when requesting user A's storage_path. ✓
test_credentials: test@atlas.com / password123 (verified). New tests also spin up fresh users.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers 2 fresh users in iter2 (user_a, user_b). Uploads a real 1x1 PNG via Emergent Object Storage — storage_path prefixed 'atlas/uploads/<user_id>/<uuid>.png'. No delete API per playbook; files remain in storage. is_deleted flag in uploaded_files collection available for soft-delete if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression baseline is now 35 tests across two files: /app/backend/tests/test_atlas_backend.py (22) + /app/backend/tests/test_atlas_iter2.py (13). Run both with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Iter2 suite takes ~5s (no AI calls); baseline takes ~37s (3 real Claude calls). Upload test creates real objects in Emergent Object Storage under atlas/uploads/<user_id>/; cleanup via is_deleted flag if needed. /api/files uses query-param token auth by design (playbook).
rca of the issue: No new issues found in iteration 2. All new endpoints behave exactly per spec. The earlier load_dotenv() fix from iteration 1 continues to hold; AI endpoints remain green.
